import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect('46.202.154.25', 22, 'root', '2N00py123+++')
# Check if there's a territory folder anywhere in the project
print('=== Check for territory anywhere ===')
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command('find /root/opt/areloria -name \"*Territory*\" 2>/dev/null')
print(stdout.read().decode())
# Check what modules are in dist
print('\\n=== Dist modules ===')
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command('ls /root/opt/areloria/server/dist/modules/ 2>/dev/null')
print(stdout.read().decode())
client.close()
"
